correctness.rationale: For any finite G and m>=1, a congruence on C_m x G restricts to convex idempotent intervals and a weak decreasing chain of normal subgroups, constant within each block. Conversely the relation defined from such data respects multiplication. The unary maximum map mu(i,g)=(m-1,g) is preserved iff every subgroup in the chain agrees. This yields exact ordinary and enriched counts. For G=(C_p)^d, GL_d orbits of weak flags are classified by dimension increments, yielding the binomial orbit count. Gaussian-multinomial sums over dimension increments, centered at d/(m+1), and discrete Gaussian dominated convergence yield the fixed-p,m periodic theta prefactor and quadratic exponential decay. Independent brute-force equivalence-relation congruence enumeration on seven small monoids corroborated ordinary/enriched counts and checked source verifier code. Special cases m=1 and trivial group explicit. All source tree hashes reconstructed.
